record.original_question: Given an (Abelian) group G viewed as the symmetry measure space (G, asdim, S) with central symmetries, calculate or estimate its dimension symmetry numbers mds_r(G).

evidence.quote: To shorten notations, by mdsr(G) we shall denote the maximal symmetry number msr(G, asdim, S) of the symmetry measure space (G, asdim, S) and call it the dimension symmetry number of G.
Problem 11.2. Given an (Abelian) group G calculate or evaluate its dimension symmetry numbers mdsr(G).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and setup. Let $G$ be a group (in particular, one may consider abelian $G$). A coloring of $G$ is a map $\chi: G \to Y$ to some set $Y$. For a subset $A \subseteq G$, write $\chi|_A$ for its restriction. Two subsets $A, B \subseteq G$ are called $\chi$-equivalent (or $\chi$-monochromatic in the same pattern) if there is a bijection $f: A \to B$ such that $\chi(f(a)) = \chi(a)$ for all $a \in A$.

A central symmetry of $G$ is a self-map of the form $s_g: x \mapsto gx^{-1}g$ for some $g \in G$. Let $S = \{s_g : g \in G\}$ denote the family of central symmetries of $G$.

Endow $G$ with its canonical left-invariant coarse structure (so that, for finitely generated $G$, balls are with respect to a word metric; in general, entourages are generated by the diagonals $\{(x, y) : y^{-1}x \in F\}$ for finite $F \subseteq G$). Let $\operatorname{asdim}$ denote the asymptotic dimension function: for a subset $A \subseteq G$, $\operatorname{asdim}(A)$ is the asymptotic dimension of $A$ with the induced coarse structure, taking values in $\{0,1,2,\dots,\infty\}$.

For an integer $r \geq 0$, the maximal symmetry number $\operatorname{ms}_r(G, \operatorname{asdim}, S)$ is defined as the supremum of those cardinals $\kappa$ such that for every coloring $\chi: G \to \kappa$ (i.e., every partition of $G$ into $\kappa$ pieces) there exist a subset $A \subseteq G$ with $\operatorname{asdim}(A) \geq r$ and a central symmetry $s \in S$ such that $\chi$ is constant on $A$ and on $s(A)$ with the same color, that is, $A$ and $s(A)$ are $\chi$-monochromatic of the same color. Denote
$$\operatorname{mds}_r(G) := \operatorname{ms}_r(G, \operatorname{asdim}, S),$$
called the $r$-th dimension symmetry number of $G$.

Problem. For a given (abelian) group $G$ and integer $r \geq 0$, compute or give nontrivial bounds for the dimension symmetry numbers $\operatorname{mds}_r(G)$. In particular, determine $\operatorname{mds}_r(\mathbb{Z}^n)$ for all $n, r \geq 0$.
artifact.category_tag: Symmetry numbers and colorings of groups
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears as an explicit open problem in Banakh's survey on symmetry and colorings (2011). No subsequent paper computing or generally estimating the dimension symmetry numbers $\operatorname{mds}_r(G)$ for arbitrary (abelian) groups was located in searches; related work on asymptotic dimension and on symmetry numbers exists, but does not resolve the general computation.
